title: Managed Backup: authoritative source review
content:
For Managed Backup, the authoritative source review basis governs source review.

## Policy clauses

The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object.

A service accountant reviews one precise source event against its authoritative export, contract terms, bank notice, tax record or incident record.

Record decision correct or incorrect for a billing review, and eligible or ineligible for an outage claim; status approved means the review is complete and authoritative, not that a credit necessarily follows.

Record corrected pretax amount and tax amount for incorrect billing, or approved credit amount for an eligible outage after applying outage credit rules.

A rejected review cannot authorize money movement.

The customer may provide a locator but cannot dictate an official decision.

Repeating the same source and request review returns the existing decision; materially new evidence is a distinct review linked through linked evidence reference.

Review alone books no money.

## Authoritative evidence

Before source review, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object.

The evidence identifies Event reference, Original source reference, Linked evidence reference, Contract reference. Match the action to that evidence by Event reference, Original source reference, Linked evidence reference, Contract reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object.

## Hypothetical case

A hypothetical billing review is approved with decision correct. Approved status makes the review authoritative; it does not mean that the source billing was incorrect or that a credit follows.
